faq.domanda: How much does it cost to wrap a vehicle in Lugano?
faq.risposta: The price depends on the size of the vehicle, the type of work (lettering and logo, partial graphics or a full wrap) and the materials chosen. Company lettering on a van costs relatively little, while a full wrap requires a larger investment. We'll prepare a free, tailored quote within 24/48 hours.

faq.domanda: How long does the vehicle wrap take?
faq.risposta: Usually 1 to 6 working days, depending on the complexity of the project and the surface to be covered. Simple lettering and logos are applied in a few hours, while a full wrap takes longer for printing, lamination and careful application.

faq.domanda: Where do you apply the graphics? Do you also cover the areas around Lugano?
faq.risposta: Application takes place at our premises in Ticino, in a controlled environment to guarantee a flawless finish. We serve the whole Lugano area and the surrounding towns, from Paradiso, Massagno and Cassarate to Agno, Bioggio and the Pian Scairolo area. For company fleets we can look at carrying out the work at your own site.

faq.domanda: Can I wrap just part of the vehicle, for example the doors?
faq.risposta: Of course. We offer both partial graphics (logo, lettering, doors, rear window) and full wraps. For many businesses in Lugano a well-designed partial wrap is already enough to get recognised, with a smaller investment.

faq.domanda: What types of vehicles can you wrap?
faq.risposta: We wrap any vehicle: private and company cars, delivery vans, minibuses, trucks and commercial vehicles. We adapt the graphics and films to the shape and surface of each vehicle.

faq.domanda: Can I see a preview before printing?
faq.risposta: Yes. Before printing we send you a design mock-up on the actual model of your vehicle, so you can assess the colours, positioning and overall look. We only move to production once you've confirmed.

faq.domanda: Do I need to wash the vehicle before application?
faq.risposta: Yes, the vehicle must arrive clean and free of waxes or treatments that could compromise the film's adhesion. If needed, we can take care of preparing the surface ourselves, at an additional cost stated in the quote.

faq.domanda: How long does a vehicle wrap last?
faq.risposta: With professional films and correct application, a wrap keeps its colours and adhesion for several years even with daily use on the roads of Lugano and across Ticino. Its lifespan depends on sun exposure, how the vehicle is stored and how often it is washed.
